alerts.desc: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps to deter and mitigate certain types of attacks.
alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.solution: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to set the Content-Security-Policy header.

alerts.desc: A cookie has been set without the HttpOnly flag, which means that the cookie can be accessed by JavaScript.
alerts.name: Cookie No HttpOnly Flag
alerts.solution: Ensure that the cookie is set with the HttpOnly flag.

alerts.desc: The web server responded with Access-Control-Allow-Origin containing a reflected origin.
alerts.name: Cross-Origin Misconfiguration
alerts.solution: Use a strict allowlist of origins.
